author: Codex
authorization_literal: Dale, revisa el nivel agregado y la influencia de pocos grupos en B03 y B05. Registra la siguiente prueba solo en 2023, conserva B00, deja los resultados en el foro y mantén 2024 cerrado.

objective.calibration: Explicit B00 training-level anchor and fixed contraction, exactly as level_rule; no held-out or public calibration
objective.primary_development_metric: Pooled unweighted total-unit D2 Tweedie 1.5 on all 50094 OOF rows of 2023; global null is arithmetic mean of observed T0; do not average line D2 scores
objective.positivity: Fail on nonfinite or nonpositive rate/prediction; no silent clipping or removal

observation_link: Each development fold k uses frozen exclude_foldk/e_cost_mix_1.0, fitted only on other 2023 groups; all three model families use exactly the same link and T0 response.
features: Exact availability_contract.blocks[line].all whitelist, no annual weather or optional profiles; metadata excluded. Numeric and categorical training transforms are fitted inside the training rows only.

level_rule.scope: For each parent, line and outer fold, use exactly the saved outer-training rows and corresponding frozen C0 exposure. No held-out labels/features/distribution for fitting the factor.
level_rule.factor: s = sum_fit(e * c0) / sum_fit(e * r_parent); c0 is the saved B00 annual constant for the same fold/line
level_rule.prediction: r_new = (1-w)*c0 + w*s*r_parent; observed prediction = e*C0_adjusted_rate, w in {1,0.5} fixed above
level_rule.anchor: B00 fitted-model level, not observed sum(Y), not OOF totals and not a private/public score
level_rule.shared_factors: Two parents * three lines * five folds = 30 positive factors, each shared between weights 1 and .5
level_rule.moment: For every outer-training fold/line, sum(e*r_new)=sum(e*c0). This is a training moment only; no held-out equality or A/E=1 guarantee.
limits: Uses fitted in-sample risk predictions for normalization; not independent or inner-OOF calibration
B00 anchor itself depends on training claims and may be influenced by severe events
Positive scaling and fixed mixing preserve within-fold/line annual-rate ordering; this does not prove sound risk shape or ultimate level

development_uncertainty.interval: 95% percentile, conditional exploratory diagnostic; NOT the 2024 Bonferroni confirmation interval
development_uncertainty.pairs: All 45 pairs of ten recipes; common 2000 exploratory component draws, no multiplicity or search correction

diagnostics.observation_sensitivity: At fixed fitted OOF rates, recompute predictions and response for reserve075, reserve125, late_cost05, late_cost10 using saved scoped links. This is an observation-only diagnostic, not a refit or the complete confirmation safeguards.
diagnostics.no_selection: Keep B00 and every alternative; no promotion, retirement, equivalence or final confirmation roster here.

readout_before_testing.level: First check exact fit moment and unchanged comparators; then report whether held-out totals move closer to B00 and observed A/E, by line/fold and business. No forcing held-out totals.
readout_before_testing.influence: Recompute each new-vs-B00 top31 removal and bootstrap. Also remove the frozen top31 favorable groups from its parent review, using the identical set across parent/anchored/shrunk variants. No removal in fit, primary score or level factor.
readout_before_testing.contraction: With w=.5, annual-rate deviation from B00 is exactly half that of the anchored parent in each fit scope. Check whether evaluation influence is reduced; no guarantee of half deviance contribution.
readout_before_testing.uncertainty: All point/interval/scenario/segment results remain exploratory after adaptive 2023 search. Retain B00 regardless of this batch readout.

technical_acceptance: Only 2023 materialized and supplied to fit-factor/predict/score
Exact parent-model, target, fold, C0 and F0 hashes
Factor rejects held-out training rows, invalid exposure/rates, or another year
30 training-only factors and 60 adapter bundles; zero new GLM/tree fits
Exact training aggregate anchor and fixed w=.5 contraction
No held-out outcomes used for scales or weights
Scales/models/OOF replay with base fit functions blocked; independent scale and metric reconstruction
All six previous OOF tables including B00 unchanged
No 2024/test prices, scores, ledger opening or final confirmation roster
scope: Local only, same 2023 five customer-address folds; no row trimming, cap, extra weights, seeds, optimization of mixing, new features, prices or test predictions.
resources: CPU, two threads; reuse 60 parent/reference bundles to learn 30 scalar factors, save 60 new adapters, reuse six OOF comparators. Expected minutes, no base-estimator retraining or remote compute.
search_disclosure: Motivated by all earlier 2023 results; four recipes fixed before their factors/predictions. No tuning on this batch; intervals do not correct adaptive search or 45 pairwise comparisons.
